name: auscultadb
description: Respiratory sound database and analysis platform on open data (SPRSound children, KAUH adults).

scripts.build:precompute: node pipeline/precompute.js cohort && node pipeline/precompute.js kauh && node pipeline/precompute.js circor
scripts.build:features: node pipeline/precompute.js features 0 1 && node pipeline/precompute.js kfeatures && node pipeline/precompute.js cbfeatures
scripts.build:apnea: python3 pipeline/psg_audio_prep.py 10 && node pipeline/psg_audio_validate.js && python3 pipeline/psg_audio_discover.py && python3 pipeline/merge.py --bump
scripts.build:discover: python3 pipeline/discover.py && python3 pipeline/person_probe.py && python3 pipeline/kauh_discover.py && python3 pipeline/circor_discover.py && python3 pipeline/cbemph_discover.py && python3 pipeline/age_discover.py && python3 pipeline/merge.py --bump
scripts.build: npm run build:index && npm run build:kauh && npm run build:circor && npm run build:cbemph && npm run build:audio && npm run build:precompute && npm run build:merge && npm run build:discover
